segments.name: regenerative medicine
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells regenerative medicine products for advanced wound care and surgical and sports medicine sold to hospitals, wound care centers and physician offices.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it has a single operating segment—regenerative medicine.

revenueModel.text: Health care providers such as hospitals, wound care centers, government facilities, ambulatory surgery centers and physician offices pay for the company's regenerative medicine products and in-house customer support.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer our differentiated products and in-house customer support to a wide range of health care customers including hospitals, wound care centers, government facilities, ambulatory surgery centers ("ASCs") and physician offices.
